test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which mountain range covers a distance of about 1500 miles (2400 km) and passes through India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, China, Bhutan, and Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himalayan mountain range**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Himalayas** stretch across the northeastern portion of India.
 
• They cover approximately **1,500 mi (2,400 km)** and pass through the nations of **India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, China, Bhutan, and Nepal.**
 
• The Himalayan range is bordered in the northwest by the **Karakoram **and the** Hindu Kush ranges.**
 
• The Himalayas have profoundly shaped the cultures of **South Asia and Tibet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Purvanchal Range or Eastern Mountains__ **is a sub-mountain range of Himalaya, covering an area of **about 94,800 km2** with a population of over four million incorporates Nagaland.
 
• __**The Aravalli Range**__ (**also spelled Aravali**) is a mountain range in Northern-Western India, running approximately** 670 km** (**430 mi**) in a south-west direction, starting near** Delhi**, passing through **southern Haryana, Rajasthan** and ending in** Ahmedabad Gujarat**.
 
• __**The Pir Panjal Range**__ (**Kashmiri: Pīr Pantsāl**) is a group of mountains in the **Lesser Himalayan region**.
 
• The Himalayas show a gradual elevation towards the** Dhauladhar and Pir Panjal ranges.**
